params.prompt:
Create ONE polished real-time 3D GAME SCREENSHOT in a five-image sequence for VESPER, a compact LINEAR walking environment whose only purpose is experiencing gradual natural climate change. This is a buildable target for a Unity game, physically grounded stylized realism, carefully authored geometry and PBR materials, not a painting, not cinematic art, not a miniature diorama.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image 1 is the existing waterside material/bridge reference; image 2 is the existing rainy Gothic ruin and traveler reference; image 3 is the existing snow/conifer reference. Retain their coherent game art direction and elevated gameplay camera, while improving natural landform, foliage and stone quality. Render ONLY the requested stage, never a collage or all climates in one image.
LOCKED ACROSS ALL FIVE IMAGES: landscape 3:2 frame; fixed elevated three-quarter game camera looking down approximately 53 degrees, near-orthographic lens without a horizon or sky band; one continuous unbranched path on exactly the same screen axis, entering around bottom x=0.28 and leaving around top x=0.74. The path is straight, with only irregular natural edges: no S bends, intersections, looping lanes, side paths, plazas or dramatic overlooks. Walkable lane approximately 3.5 metres wide. Camera sees around 22 metres of the route, not the entire 300m world. Same small human adventurer, brown short hair, off-white long-sleeved tunic, brown leather vest and boots, short dark teal shoulder cape, no armor or large weapon, seen from behind, feet near screen (0.50,0.62), body height about 13% of the image. Same human, scale, direction and camera every stage. Local natural terrain continues beyond all frame edges; no floating island, cutaway terrain or stage platform. Ground clear around traveler. Detailed warm-gray weathered limestone family, irregular large slabs blending into earth, natural varied foliage clusters and grounded rock outcrops with fine contact shadows. Restrained believable colors, clean crisp rendered image, no depth-of-field blur, no HUD, labels, text, logo, border, panel, watermark or visible numerical markers.
WORLD CONTINUITY: the player proceeds in a straight route from a sunny river crossing through a damp deciduous wood past a small rainy ruined abbey, then a frosty gradual rise into a snowy conifer pass. Moisture, species, rock exposure, light and precipitation evolve gradually. Architecture is compact, human-scale. Do not enlarge the map to make an epic vista.

STAGE 1, SUNNY WATERSIDE, around route 25m. The traveler is crossing a compact, substantial low limestone arched bridge along the locked straight path axis. A shallow clear turquoise stream runs perpendicular underneath; one readable masonry arch and lower natural layered rock banks, visible submerged stones, warm dense irregular golden reed clusters on both banks, one graceful leafy alder framing the right edge. Low weathered parapets with worn coping, large irregular pale bridge slabs merging into grass beyond the bridge, no ruler-straight pavement termination. Soft warm daylight and coherent fine water glints, gentle shadows, fresh muted green grass. Far end of the same straight path enters slightly denser greener trees with subtly cooler shade. It is fully dry and sunny here, no rain or snow. Keep the riverbanks low and compact and make the whole space feel reachable.
